appearance_facts.fact: The pie chart is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The chart is divided into four colored segments.
The segment labeled 'Nuclear (45%)' is light yellow.
The segment labeled 'Fossil Fuels (30%)' is dark red.
The segment labeled 'Renewables (15%)' is light orange.
The 'Nuclear' segment occupies the largest area of the pie chart.
The 'Fossil Fuels' segment is the second largest segment.

printed_facts.fact: The 'Nuclear' segment is labeled with the text 'Nuclear (45%)'.
The 'Hydroelectric' segment is labeled with the text 'Hydroelectric (10%)'.
The 'Fossil Fuels' segment is labeled with the text 'Fossil Fuels (30%)'.
The 'Renewables' segment is labeled with the text 'Renewables (15%)'.
The chart's legend is embedded within the segments, with each label and percentage printed directly on the corresponding segment.

public_definitions: The goal is to identify the largest global energy consumption source category from the dashboard and route that source record to priority source monitoring.
The comparison scope is the global energy mix dashboard, specifically the pie chart showing consumption by source.
The rules are to use the dashboard to determine the largest category and route that specific source record to priority source monitoring.
